title: PS-Suitcase
description: A high-tech, 54-slot portable storage solution for NeoForge 1.21.1 that allows instant access via keybind from anywhere in your inventory.
body:
# PS Suitcase - Smart Portable Storage

**PS Suitcase** is a lightweight, Vanilla-style utility mod for **NeoForge**. It solves the age-old problem of a cluttered inventory by adding a portable, high-capacity suitcase that you can manage directly from your pocket.

---

## Core Features

### Double Chest Capacity
Each suitcase provides **54 slots** of storage space. This is equivalent to a vanilla Double Chest, allowing you to carry massive amounts of blocks, ores, or loot without bulky backpacks.

### Instant Access (Hotkey 'K')
Stop placing chests on the ground! 
* Open your suitcase instantly by pressing the **'K' key**.
* The mod automatically detects the suitcase in your inventory—you don't even need to hold it in your hand.

### Smart-Switch System
If you carry multiple suitcases, you can cycle through them effortlessly:
* While the GUI is open, use the **Left & Right Arrow Keys** to switch between all suitcases in your inventory.
* Perfect for organizing your items into categories like "Mining", "Building", and "Food".

### Dynamic In-Game Renaming
Personalize your storage without the need for an anvil:
* **To Rename:** Click the suitcase name at the top of the interface.
* **To Save:** Press **Enter** or click anywhere outside the text field.
* **To Cancel:** Press **ESC** to discard your changes.
The custom name will be saved to the item and displayed in your inventory!

---

## Crafting Recipe

The PS Suitcase is balanced for survival gameplay and can be crafted early on:

| | | |
| :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Leather | Leather | Leather |
| Chest | Iron Ingot | Chest |
| Leather | Leather | Leather |~~~~

---

## Technical Information

* **Mod Loader:** NeoForge
* **Supported Version:** 1.21.1
* **Design:** Clean, "Basic" Vanilla+ interface that fits perfectly into any modpack.

---

## How to Use
1. Craft your suitcase.
2. Keep it anywhere in your inventory.
3. Press **'K'** to open.
4. Click the title to rename it.
5. Use **Arrow Keys** to switch between multiple suitcases.

**Found a bug or have a suggestion?** Feel free to leave a comment or report issues on the project page!
